<DESCRIPTION>AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT BETWEEN VIRAL GENETICS, INC. AND TIMOTHY & THOMAS, LLC, MR. TIMOTHY WRIGHT, AND MR. THOMAS LITTLE, DATED OCTOBER 19, 2010, EFFECTIVE DECEMBER 28 2012

<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.34</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><U>AMENDMENT</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">This AMENDMENT effective as of December
28, 2012 (this &quot;Amendment&quot;), by and among Timothy and Thomas LLC (the &quot;Holder&quot;), and VG Life Sciences Inc. formally
known as Viral Genetics, Inc. a Delaware corporation (the &quot;Company&quot;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The Holder and the Company are parties to
a Convertible Debenture (See attached schedule &quot;A&quot;) made the 19th day of October 2010 (the &quot;Agreement&quot;), and
the Holder and the Company desire to amend and modify the Agreement as provided for in this Amendment. See attached schedule A3.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Holder and the Company realize that an orderly liquidation
of the debenture will have a maximum beneficial effect on both parties.&#9;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">NOW THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration,
the receipt and legal adequacy of which is hereby acknowledged, it is agreed as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">1. <U>Capitalized Terms</U>. Capitalized
terms used in this Amendment which are not defined herein shall have the same meanings herein as are ascribed to such terms in
the Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">2. <U>Principal</U>. Section 3 of the Agreement
is amended to provide that the remaining Tranches of the Note shall be paid as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Pursuant to attached schedule &quot;B&quot;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">3. <U>Effect</U>. Except as expressly amended
hereby, the Agreement shall remain in full force and effect in accordance with its terms.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have
executed this Amendment as of the date first above written.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Timothy and Thomas, LLC</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><U>SCHEDULE B</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Release schedule base on stock price</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Amount of convertible debt remaining under the agreement &#9;$
862,500.00</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Price per share is defined as 15 day weighted average at closing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Mandatory quarterly conversion if price per share is</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">$1.00 is $50,000.00 or greater as mutual agreed upon by the
parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Mandatory quarterly conversion if price per share is</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">$2.00 is $75,000.00 or greater as mutual agreed upon by the
parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">All other term as to price, definitions, terms and option stay
the same. This schedule only effects the liquidation of the debt.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">If the price is below a dollar then note is convertible</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">01/01/2020</P>
